# Runtime license sources

- `rusty-v8-MIT.txt`: `denoland/rusty_v8`, tag `v150.4.0`, `LICENSE`.
- `V8-BSD.txt`: that tag's V8 submodule, `denoland/v8`, commit
  `ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896`, `LICENSE`.

Keep these notices aligned with the pinned runtime when updating V8. Android
packages also include the selected NDK's `NOTICE` and `NOTICE.toolchain` for the
bundled C++ runtime and compiler support code. Other source notices remain with
their respective upstream components.
